children.name: Attribute Extraction from Method Calls
children.description: Extract telemetry attributes (e.g., model name, token usage) from LLM method arguments and return values using a structured AttributeMap handler. Normalizes observable metadata into OpenTelemetry-compliant keys for downstream observability systems.
children.applicable_when: Extract telemetry attributes (e.g., model name, token usage) from LLM method arguments and return values using a structured AttributeMap handler. Normalizes observable metadata into OpenTelemetry-compliant keys for downstream observability systems.
selector_terms: An instrumented LLM method is called; args, kwargs, or return_value contain model, usage, or other observable metadata.
